$comment: Structural (v1) schema for .flow.json — mirrors workflow_engine::schema::{WorkflowDefinition, Action} field-for-field. Deliberately permissive on the four container-only fields (foreach/until/limit/actions/expression/else/catch) and on `inputs` (whose real per-action-type shape lives in the ActionDef registry at runtime, not statically knowable here) rather than enforcing the allOf/if/then per-`type` conditional rules a stricter v2 could add. Goal is to catch malformed JSON, wrong field types, and typo'd field names without false-positiving on legitimate flows.
title: Workflow Definition

name.description: Display name shown in the Designer canvas tab and flows panel.

actions.description: Top-level actions map. Keys are action ids, unique within this map.

outputs.description: Flow-level outputs, each a JSONLogic expression evaluated against run state.

type.description: Action type id, resolved against the ActionDef registry at runtime — not enumerated here.

inputs.description: Per-action-type input shape, defined by the ActionDef registry — deliberately unvalidated here.

runAfter.description: Maps a dependency action id (in the same actions map) to the outcome(s) that must occur before this action runs.

foreach.description: Foreach-only: a JSONLogic expression evaluating to the collection to iterate.

until.description: Until-only: a JSONLogic expression evaluating to the loop's exit condition.

limit.description: Until-only (mandatory on every real Until action, not enforced structurally here).

actions.description: Foreach/Until body, or If's true-branch body, or Try's try-body — same recursive shape as the top-level actions map.

expression.description: If-only: a JSONLogic expression deciding which branch runs.
